DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 五センチくらいの長さを残すご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like about five centimeters left, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 違います。今から五センチ切るつもりでした。残す長さではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切る量と残す長さの誤解を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. I meant to have five centimeters cut off from now. That's not the length I want left.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the misunderstanding between how much to cut and how much length to leave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切る量と仕上がりを分けて確認しましょう。まだ切っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the amount to cut separately from the finished result. I haven't cut it yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今の長さからどこまでになるか、鏡で示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未切断で仕上がり位置を鏡で求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. Could you show me in the mirror where it would end up compared with its current length?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Before any cutting, ask to see the finished position in the mirror. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この位置が目安です。前髪も同じ量を切るご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is roughly where it would be. Would you like the same amount cut off your fringe?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前髪は別です。全て五センチではなく、前髪の形を見て相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前髪を別条件として相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: My fringe is separate. I don't want five centimeters off everything; I'd like to discuss it while looking at the fringe's shape.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss the fringe as a separate condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの仕上がりを示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll show you the finished position of each part.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 示された所を確認します。髪を結べるかも、切る前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認した位置で結べる希望も伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check the positions you've shown. I'd also like to discuss whether I'll still be able to tie my hair up before you cut it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the indicated position and explain that you also want to tie your hair up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 仕上がりと普段の使い方を合わせて考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's consider the finished result together with how you usually wear your hair.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では後ろと前髪の位置を確認し、結ぶ希望も含めて合意してから切ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部位と用途の合意後に切るよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then please check the positions for the back and fringe and cut only after we agree, including my wish to tie it up.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for cutting to begin only after agreement on the different parts and intended use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その確認が済んでから始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll start after we've finished checking that.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 飲み物の追加注文は、この時刻で終了です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Additional drink orders close at this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 席も同時に終わると思いました。料理が残っていますが、すぐ出る必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 飲物注文終了で即退店か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought our seating time ended at the same time too. We still have food left; do we need to leave immediately?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the end of drink ordering means you must leave immediately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注文できる時間と席の案内は別です。ご予約の条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The ordering period and seating instructions are separate. I'll check your booking conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つを同じ時刻と読んでいました。席の利用終了と退店の手順を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 席利用終了と退店手順を別に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had read both as the same time. Please explain when use of the seats ends and the procedure for leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask separately about the seating end time and departure procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この教材の席の案内はこちらです。飲み物は追加できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the seating information for this learning scenario. You can't order any more drinks.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 席が続くから飲み物も延長されたとは考えません。残っている料理を食べられる時間を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 席継続を飲物延長と扱わず食事時間を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't assume that because we can stay seated, drink ordering has been extended too. I'll check how long we have to eat the remaining food.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the remaining dining time without treating continued seating as extended drink ordering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認した時間内でご利用ください。追加の有料注文も条件を聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please use the seats within the confirmed time. Ask about the conditions for additional paid orders too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は追加しません。同行者へ二つの時間を説明し、席の案内に合わせて片付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加せず同行者へ二時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't add anything now. I'll explain the two times to my companions and tidy up according to the seating instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not add orders and tell your companions the two times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会計方法も、終わる前に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also check how to pay before your time ends.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。飲み物終了と席の終了を分けて伝え、案内された手順で会計して出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件に合わせて会計退店を行う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please explain. I'll distinguish the end of drink ordering from the end of seating when I tell them, and pay and leave following the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pay and leave in accordance with the conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では席の条件と会計をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll explain the seating conditions and payment.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この五個の検査結果を報告してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please report the inspection results for these five parts.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 傷とへこみがあったので、不良品は二個と書きました。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二種類の不具合を不良品二個と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was a scratch and a dent, so I wrote that there were two defective parts.
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report two types of defects as two defective parts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 傷とへこみは、同じ部品にありましたか。それぞれ別の部品ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Were the scratch and dent on the same part, or on separate parts?

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ一個です。不具合の種類を二つ見つけたので、部品の数も二個にしていました。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ部品で種類数と個数を混同したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-04.translation: They were on the same single part. Since I found two types of defects, I counted the parts as two as well.
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that both defects were on one part and you confused defect types with item count. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 部品の個数と不具合の内訳を分けて、実物と記録を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the actual items and records, separating the part count from the breakdown of defects.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この番号の一個に傷とへこみがあります。残りの四個の結果とは分けて示します。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 該当部品番号と二種類を残り四個から分け示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-06.translation: The single part with this number has both a scratch and a dent. I'll show it separately from the results for the other four parts.
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the part number and two defect types separately from the other four parts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録の訂正方法も確認します。すでに二個として次の担当へ報告しましたか。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll also check how to correct the record. Have you already reported two parts to the next person in charge?

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ渡していません。二個と書いた表を黙って渡さず、訂正する箇所を担当と確認します。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未引継ぎを伝え表の訂正を担当と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't passed it on yet. Rather than silently handing over the sheet saying two, I'll check the correction points with the staff member.
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have not handed it over and check the sheet correction with the staff member. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 判定基準は別に照合します。不具合が見えることだけで、処分まで決めないでください。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll compare the assessment criteria separately. Don't decide to dispose of it just because you can see defects.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。一個に二種類を見つけた事実を報告し、集計の訂正と判定を確認してから引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 個数訂正と判定を分け処分を自己決定せず引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll report that I found two types on one part and hand it over after checking the tally correction and assessment.
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the count correction from the assessment and hand it over without deciding disposal yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その一個と集計表をこちらへ示してください。一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show me that one part and the tally sheet. We'll check them together.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の車についてご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about your reserved car?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 四人で大きいケースを四つ持ちます。この写真の荷室なら、全部積めると思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 四人と四ケースの予定を荷室写真で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: There will be four of us with four large cases. I think we can fit everything in the luggage area shown in this photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss your plan for four people and four cases using the luggage-area photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その写真では後席を倒しています。四人が座る状態の荷室とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The rear seats are folded down in that photo. It's different from the luggage area when four people are seated.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 四人乗る条件を見落としていました。席を倒さない状態で荷物の相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 倒した後席と四人乗車の条件差を認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I overlooked the condition that four people would be riding. I'd like to discuss the luggage with the seats not folded down.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the difference between folded rear seats and seating four people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物の寸法と人数で、担当が車の候補を確認します。ケースの大きさは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check possible cars using the luggage dimensions and passenger count. Do you know the case sizes?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 寸法のメモがあります。荷物を座席に置いて一人の席をなくす方法は希望しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物寸法を示し乗員席を荷物で減らさない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a note of the dimensions. I don't want to put luggage on a seat and eliminate one person's seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the luggage dimensions and do not reduce passenger seating to hold luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 四人の乗車と荷物を両方条件として確認します。車の変更は料金と空き状況の説明が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check both seating for four and the luggage as conditions. A car change requires an explanation of prices and availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の予約を先に取り消さず、変更候補と追加料金を聞いてから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 既存予約を維持して候補と料金説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to hear the alternatives and additional fees before deciding, without canceling my current booking first.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the existing booking and request an explanation of alternatives and fees. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が案内します。写真だけで積載できると確約した扱いにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will explain. We won't treat the photo alone as a guarantee that the luggage will fit.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。四人分の席を使う条件と荷物寸法を示し、説明後に予約をどうするか伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人数と寸法を条件に説明後の予約判断を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll give the condition that we need all four seats and the luggage dimensions, then tell you what to do with the booking after the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the passenger count and dimensions as conditions and decide on the booking after the explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その条件で候補を確認します。現在の予約情報もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll check options under those conditions. Please also bring your current booking information.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ち帰りの品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for something to take away?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人へ買いたいです。何かの食材を避けていたので、野菜だけならよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の不明確な食物制限で野菜を選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to buy something for my friend. They were avoiding some ingredient, so I thought something made only of vegetables would be fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to choose vegetables for a friend whose food restrictions you do not clearly know. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 避ける必要のある内容が分からないまま、野菜料理ならよいとは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can't judge that a vegetable dish is suitable without knowing what needs to be avoided.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 何を避けるか本人に聞いていませんでした。先に友人へ確認するので、まだ注文しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人未確認を認め連絡まで注文を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I hadn't asked them what they need to avoid. I'll check with my friend first, so please don't place the order yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge you have not checked with the person and hold the order until you contact them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お返事の内容に合わせて、材料や調理条件は担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Based on their reply, you can check ingredients and cooking conditions with the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人から返事が来ました。本人の説明を省略せずに担当へ伝え、対応を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の返答を省かず担当へ伝えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend has replied. I'd like to pass their explanation to the staff member without leaving anything out and check what can be accommodated.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to pass the person's reply to the staff member without omissions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当を呼びます。料理の説明を聞いて、友人にも確認してから選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll call the staff member. You can hear the dish explanation and check with your friend too before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私だけで大丈夫と返事せず、説明された条件をそのまま友人へ伝えます。了承前には買いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店の説明を本人へ伝え了承前に購入しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't reply on my own that it's fine. I'll pass the explained conditions on to my friend as they are, and won't buy before they agree.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Pass the restaurant's explanation to the person and do not buy before their agreement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対応が難しい場合もあります。その際は無理に代わりの料理を決める必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: There may be cases we can't accommodate. In that case, you don't have to force a choice of another dish.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。条件を確認できなければ、今日は料理の土産をやめると友人に伝えます。まず担当の説明を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件が確認できなければ土産をやめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. If the conditions can't be confirmed, I'll tell my friend I won't bring food as a gift today. First, I'll wait for the staff member's explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will abandon the food gift if the conditions cannot be confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人から確認した内容を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please tell the staff member what you confirmed directly with your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 組立についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need advice about assembly?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ねじが二本残っています。全部使わないと完成ではないと思い、どこかへ足そうとしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残ったねじを全部追加すべきと思ったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two screws left. I thought it wasn't finished unless I used them all, so I was about to add them somewhere.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought all leftover screws should be added. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 残った部品には予備の場合もあります。説明書の部品一覧と工程を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Leftover parts may be spares. Let's check the manual's parts list and assembly steps.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ足していません。袋の本数だけで判断せず、説明書と使った本数を見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未追加と伝え部品一覧と使用本数の照合を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't added them yet. Rather than judging from the number in the bag alone, I'd like you to look at the manual and the number I've used.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not added them and ask to compare the parts list with the number used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一覧では予備の欄が別です。どの工程まで進めたかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The list has a separate spare-parts section. We'll also check how far you've progressed.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最後の図まで進めましたが、固定の確認はまだです。ねじが余っただけで完成とも言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最終工程まで進めたが固定未確認と申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've reached the final diagram, but haven't checked the fastening yet. I'll also avoid calling it finished just because there are screws left over.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that you reached the final step but have not checked the fastening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が説明書に沿って確認点を案内します。指定のない場所へ穴を増やさないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will show you the check points in the manual. Don't add holes where none are specified.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 穴は増やしません。予備の二本は分けて保管し、指定された確認箇所を見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定外の穴を増やさず予備を別保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't add holes. I'll store the two spare screws separately and review the designated check points.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not add unspecified holes and store the spares separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真で分からない箇所は追加の確認が必要です。使う前に不明点を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Areas that can't be assessed from photos need additional checking. Let's organize the uncertainties before you use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。予備の存在と組立の確認は別にし、確認できていない状態では使わず、担当へ相談を続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予備と完成確認を分け不明点解消まで使用を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll separate the existence of spare parts from checking the assembly, avoid using it while it remains unconfirmed, and continue consulting the staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate spares from completion checks and wait to use it until uncertainties are resolved. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では説明書の工程番号で確認します。残ったねじもそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll check by the step numbers in the manual. Please also bring the leftover screws unchanged.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらが応募先への紹介状です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is the referral letter for the employer you're applying to.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: これをもらえたので、家族には採用が決まったと伝えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紹介状で採用決定を家族に伝えられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Now that I've received this, can I tell my family I've been hired?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether receiving a referral letter means you can tell your family you have been hired. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紹介状の発行と、応募先の採用決定は違います。これからの選考の案内を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Issuing a referral letter and the employer deciding to hire you are different. Let's check the upcoming selection process.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仕事が決まった通知ではなかったのですね。面接の日時は、この紙だけで確定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 採用と区別し面接日程の確定状況を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it wasn't a notice that I got the job. Does this paper alone confirm the interview date and time?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish it from hiring and ask whether the interview schedule is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では応募先と日程の確認が必要です。連絡方法はこちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this scenario, you need to confirm the schedule with the employer. The contact method is here.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に日程を確認します。今の職場へ退職日を伝える根拠として、この紹介状だけを使わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 応募先に日程確認し紹介状だけで退職判断をしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll confirm the schedule first. I'll avoid using this referral letter alone as grounds to tell my current workplace my resignation date.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the schedule with the employer and do not base a resignation decision on the referral letter alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 応募に必要な書類も確認してください。紹介状とは別に準備する物があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the documents required to apply. Some things must be prepared separately from the referral letter.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 履歴書はまだ準備中です。紹介状が出たので応募書類も全部そろった、と考えず準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 履歴書未準備と申告し別書類をそろえる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm still preparing my resume. I won't assume all application documents are ready just because the referral letter was issued; I'll prepare them.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that the resume is not ready and prepare the separate documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分からない点があれば、連絡前に質問を整理できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If anything is unclear, you can organize your questions before making contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。家族には応募の紹介を受けた段階と伝え、書類と日程を確認して選考へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族へ応募段階と説明し書類日程確認後に進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll tell my family I'm at the stage of receiving a referral to apply, and proceed to selection after checking the documents and schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the application stage to your family and proceed after checking documents and the schedule. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この連絡方法と必要書類の案内をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take this information on contacting them and the required documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 得点表示についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the score display?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人のレーンで一回投げました。自分の画面には入っていないので、点を足してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 隣レーンで投げた得点を自分へ追加したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bowled once in my friend's lane. It isn't on my screen, so could you add the points for me?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to add to your score a throw made in the next lane. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのレーンで、誰の順番に投げたか確認が必要です。自分の記録へそのまま加えることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check which lane and whose turn you bowled on. We won't simply add it to your record.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人の名前が出た時に投げました。自分の順番を隣へ移せると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の順番で投げたことと誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I bowled when my friend's name was displayed. I thought I could move my turn to the neighboring lane.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you bowled during your friend's turn and describe the misunderstanding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つのレーンの進行を係が確認します。いったん次の投球を待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check the progress of both lanes. Please wait before the next throw for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 待ちます。友人にも自分の投球だったと伝え、さらに点を直そうとして操作しないよう頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 投球を止め友人にも勝手な記録操作を止めてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll wait. I'll tell my friend it was my throw too, and ask them not to operate the controls to try to adjust the score further.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Stop bowling and ask your friend to stop changing the records themselves too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 係が記録を確認して、案内できる対応を説明します。手入力で元に戻せるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will check the records and explain the available response. It may not be possible to restore it by manual entry.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 点だけを移すのではなく、友人の順番と自分の残りの順番をどう扱うか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 得点移動だけでなく双方の順番の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to ask how to handle my friend's turn and my remaining turns, rather than just moving the points.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how both people's turns will be handled, not just the transfer of points. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が説明します。両方のレーン番号を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will explain. Please tell us both lane numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらが六番、友人が七番です。二つの番号と投げた時の名前を伝え、案内後に再開します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両レーン番号と表示名を伝え確認後に再開する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: This is lane six, and my friend's is seven. I'll give both numbers and the name displayed when I bowled, and resume after the guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give both lane numbers and the displayed name and resume after checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その情報で確認します。今は両方の次の投球をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check using that information. For now, please wait before the next throws in both lanes.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのラジオをご検討ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電池が入っているので、店で動作を確かめた物だと思いました。家でもそのまま使えますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電池入りを動作確認済みと考えたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It has batteries in it, so I thought the shop had tested it. I can use it just as it is at home too, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you took the presence of batteries to mean it had been tested. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 電池が入っていることと、動作確認の記録は別です。商品札の確認範囲を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Having batteries installed and a record of testing are different. Let's look at the scope of checks on the product tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電池の存在だけで判断していました。電源だけでなく、音を受信できたかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電源と受信の確認範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was judging just from the batteries being there. I'd like to check whether it received sound, not only whether it powered on.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the scope of checks for power and reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が記録を調べます。店内で受信を試せる条件も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check the records. We'll also check the conditions for trying reception inside the shop.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で札を外して操作せず、担当の案内で試します。古い電池が商品に含まれるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 無断操作せず案内で試し電池付属を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't remove the tag and operate it myself; I'll try it under the staff member's guidance. I'd also like to ask whether the old batteries are included with the product.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Try it with guidance rather than unauthorized operation and check whether batteries are included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 電池の扱いと、保証の対象は別に案内します。確認前に両方付くとは決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain the battery arrangements and warranty coverage separately. Don't assume both are included before checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 試用、電池の付属、保証の三つを分けて聞きます。動かなければ電池を替えるだけで直るとも思いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 試用付属保証を分け電池交換で修復を断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask about the trial, included batteries and warranty separately. If it doesn't work, I won't assume simply replacing the batteries will fix it either.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate trial use, included items and warranty without declaring a battery change will repair it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が来ました。記録と商品を一緒にご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member is here. Please look at the records and product together.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。受信の確認範囲と付属品、保証の説明を聞いてから、購入するか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三つの説明を聞いてから購入を判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll decide whether to buy after hearing the scope of reception testing, included accessories and warranty.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide whether to buy after hearing the three explanations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順にご説明します。現状の電池は、確認前に取り出さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll explain them in that order. Please don't remove the current batteries before we've checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申告のどの点を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which point about your declaration would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この控えに受付とあります。今年も提出済みだと思うので、確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受付控えを今年の提出済み証拠として確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: This copy says it was received. I think I've submitted this year's too, so could you check?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for confirmation using the acknowledgment copy as evidence of this year's submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 控えの対象年と受付日時を確認しましょう。どの申告で受け取った物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the year covered by the copy and the date and time of receipt. Which declaration did you receive it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前年の申告の物でした。今年の書類と同じ袋へ入れていたので取り違えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えが前年で同袋保管による取り違いと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was for the previous year's declaration. I mixed them up because I'd put it in the same bag as this year's documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the copy is for the previous year and you mixed them up by storing them in the same bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回の申告について、入力や送信の記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: For the current declaration, do you have records of entering or sending it?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入力途中の画面はありますが、送信完了の記録は見つかりません。前年の控えを今年の証拠として使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今年は入力画面だけで完了記録未発見と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a screen showing the entry in progress, but I can't find a record of completed transmission. I won't use last year's copy as evidence for this year.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that this year you have only the entry screen and have not found a completion record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の状態は、対象年を含めて担当が確認します。重ねて送信する前に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will check the current status, including the year concerned. Let's check before sending it again.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。未提出と自分で決めて再送することもせず、今年の画面と前年の控えを別に示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未提出断定と再送を避け年別に資料を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't decide myself that it hasn't been submitted and resend it either. I'll show this year's screen and last year's copy separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid declaring it unsubmitted or resending it, and present the materials by year. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認に必要な資料を案内します。締切についてのご相談もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll explain the documents needed to check. Do you also have a question about the deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今年の対象と期限も確認したいです。受付状態が分かってから、必要な手順を担当に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今年の期限と受付状態確認後の手順を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like to check the applicable year and deadline for this year's declaration too. Once the receipt status is clear, I'll ask the staff member what steps are needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about this year's deadline and the next steps after checking the receipt status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では二つの年の資料を分けたまま、今年の状態から確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then, keeping the documents for the two years separate, we'll start by checking this year's status.
